scientific_limitations_and_integrity.evidence: Analytic proof and a reproducible synthetic-frequency check; no external validation or independent review.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limits: Not a field calibration, statistical noise analysis, general open-path theorem or determination of absolute concentration; phase inversion ill-conditioned as response length tends to zero or infinity.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.literature_priority: Best-knowledge comparison of inspected field-monitoring and sensor-response literature; broader system-identification priority not fully excluded.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.model_conditions: Two nonzero spatial harmonics; positive unknown gains, arbitrary baselines, unknown constant registration shift; same known scanning speed; steady periodic response.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact identifiability for stationary 2pi-periodic positive fields under one equal first-order pole for both scan directions; not a data-driven finding.

title: Two-harmonic self-calibration of antiparallel mobile pollutant scans
